github_actions.workflow: OCODE Universal Wrapper v0.3 Founder Proof

scope: one intent, one Dream Intake screen, one Expo/TypeScript adapter, one test suite, one reconstruction, one continuation package
vision_progress_actual: Natural-language intent is converted into a platform-neutral semantic contract.
A minimum applicable law set is compiled into fewer visible control groups.
One replaceable adapter generates real TypeScript and React Native source.
Generated model and persistence behavior executes under automated tests.
Five critical behaviors survive the bounded manifest-assisted reconstruction cycle.
A portable continuation package and evidence receipt are generated.
new_weakest_barrier: The generated React Native screen has not yet been bundled by Expo or executed on Otto's actual iPhone, so runtime and founder-control usability remain unproven.
next_path_candidates: Expo bundle and phone preview of the same one-screen proof
Independent second adapter reproducing the same semantic contract
Repair any founder-control or maintainability issue discovered during review
not_claimed: permanent selection of Expo as the Dream Builder architecture
truth_boundary: Automated evidence proves deterministic generation, Node-executed model and storage behavior, structural screen checks, and one bounded reconstruction pattern. It does not prove device execution, production operation, or universal translation.
